# Lynn C. Jackson & Mitsawokett Delmarva Family Archive

> A digital genealogical preservation archive and research engine documenting the Nanticoke, Moor, and Lenape families of the Delmarva Peninsula (Delaware, Eastern Shore Maryland, Southern New Jersey).

## Archival Routes
- [Lineages Directory](/lineages): Historical lineage portals organized by Delmarva maternal surnames (Davis, Durham, Clark, Carney, Dean, Jackson, Mosley, Seeney, Sockum).
- [Ancestor Explorer](/ancestors): 3,780-person faceted explorer with historical era, state, surname, and media filters.
- [Kinship Network](/network): Interactive force-directed network graph modeling interconnected Delmarva community lines.
- [Migration Atlas & Cemeteries](/atlas): Historical migration atlas, settlement areas, and GPS coordinates for 13 community cemeteries.
- [Primary Records & Deeds](/records): Catalog of 357 primary documents with dual-pane high-resolution transcription viewer.
- [Community Obituaries](/obituaries): Full-text searchable vault of 401 historical obituaries.
- [Interconnection Matrix](/interconnections): Inter-marriage matrix modeling community relationships across generations.
- [Oral Histories](/oral-histories): Audio recordings and transcripts with community elders.
- [Sources & Citations](/sources): GPS evidence model citation repository (Chicago 17th ed., Evidence Explained).

## API Endpoints
- [Archive Metrics](/api/stats.json): Aggregate archive metrics and dataset distributions.
- [Surnames Directory](/api/surnames.json): Directory of cataloged surnames and member counts.
- [Persons Summary Index](/api/persons_summary.json): Lightweight directory of all cataloged individuals.
- [Primary Records Index](/api/records_catalog.json): Index of all 357 primary historical documents.
- [Full-Text Search Index](/api/search_index.json): Full-text search index covering ancestors, obituaries, and deeds.
- [Cemetery GPS Locations](/api/cemeteries.json): 13 Delmarva cemetery locations, burial counts, and GPS coordinates.
- [Master Sources Repository](/api/sources.json): Master bibliography and archival holdings catalog.
- [Kinship Network Graph](/api/graph.json): Kinship network graph nodes and relationship edges.
